objective.text: Follow Altano or meet him in the Temple of Stendarr

movedBy.speaker: Altano

objective.text: Follow Altano or meet him in Whiterun's Hall of the Dead

movedBy.speaker: Altano
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Altano of zzzAoMMq01 (Bloodsucker) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Is there any work I can help with?
reply: A priest of Arkay in Whiterun has requested our assistance. It seems they have some problems with a vampire.
I want you to accompany me. Hurry up and prepare for the journey, that vampire won't wait for us.

firstObjective.text: Talk to Altano in the Bannered Mare

objective.text: Defeat the Daedra

movedBy.speaker: Altano
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Altano of zzzAoMMq02 (He Who Cannot Be Touched) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Did you notice anything unusual happening?
reply: A Daedra destroyed a house outside the city walls a few hours ago. People heard it laughing and apparently it's still in the house.
They also saw a woman who could be its summoner. Our mission now is to banish that Daedra and seize its summoner. Let's go.
movedBy.conditions: fn67 == 1; He Who Cannot Be Touched stage < 10; the speaker is the one in alias Altano

firstObjective.text: Talk to Altano in the Bannered Mare

firstObjective.text: Talk to Altano in Candlehearth Hall

objective.text: Investigate the rumors about the Eye of Madness

movedBy.speaker: Altano
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Altano of zzzAoMMq04 (The Eye of Madness) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: You look troubled. What's wrong?
reply: I overheard a strange rumor from the guards. Apparently, there's a sinister man in Kynesgrove... They say that anyone who makes eye contact with him goes insane.
As Vigilants of Stendarr, we can't overlook something like that. Go to Kynesgrove and check out this rumor.

objective.text: (Optional) Negotiate with Altano

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mom of zzzAoMMq08 (No Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: I am a Vigilant of Stendarr. I'm looking for the witch living here.
reply: ...Lillian, run! We have to run!
movedBy.conditions: No Mercy stage < 200; the speaker is the one in alias Mom

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mom of zzzAoMMq08 (No Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: All right, I don't see a problem here, then. But this place isn't safe. You should leave, quickly.
reply: But if you're here, then that means... yes. Yes, I understand.
My daughter and I will leave as soon as we can. Stendarr bless you.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Mom

objective.text: Defeat the Daedra

movedBy.speaker: Altano
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Altano of zzzAoMMq09 (The Endless Fall) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Why in Oblivion are you doing this, Altano?
reply: I have nothing more to say to the dying.
Genghis, send this soul to Molag Bal. I must return to the altar and continue with the ritual.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Altano

objective.text: Destroy the Mace of Molag Bal

movedBy.speaker: Altano
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Altano of zzzAoMMq10 (The Landing) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Rest in peace, Altano... Stendarr be with you.
reply: I'm so sorry... I...
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Altano

objective.text: Stop Carene

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mother of zzzAoMMqGoodEnd (Art of Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: I killed him in self-defense. Neither of us could give up, and we couldn't come to an agreement.
reply: Oh, I'm sure that's true. Perhaps you really had a reason. But I still can't forgive you.
Draw your weapon. I will avenge my husband's death here and now.
movedBy.conditions: Art of Mercy stage < 10; the speaker is the one in alias Mother

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mother of zzzAoMMqGoodEnd (Art of Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Don't even think about revenge. You'll just make your daughter an orphan.
reply: Are you trying to scare me? Do you really think you won't be the one to die here? How dare a rogue like you call yourself a Vigilant!
I'm... I'm going to kill you, right here. I won't spend the rest of my days mourning over my husband's murder!
movedBy.conditions: Art of Mercy stage < 10; the speaker is the one in alias Mother

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mother of zzzAoMMqGoodEnd (Art of Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: No. I don't want to see any more blood today.
reply: Oh, I'm sure you don't. You've killed so many and spilled so much blood already, you're tired of looking at it!
But I'll show you the color of your own blood for a change. Let that be your atonement!
movedBy.conditions: Art of Mercy stage < 10; the speaker is the one in alias Mother

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mother of zzzAoMMqGoodEnd (Art of Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Everything the Vigil does is just. Taranis' death was therefore justified as well.
reply: You crazy bastard! I'll kill you!
movedBy.conditions: Art of Mercy stage < 10; the speaker is the one in alias Mother

movedBy.speaker: Carene
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias Mother of zzzAoMMqGoodEnd (Art of Mercy) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Vengeance... Fine, have it your way. Come on, then.
reply: You don't have to tell me what to do! Now, prepare yourself!
movedBy.conditions: Art of Mercy stage < 10; the speaker is the one in alias Mother

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
